title: Create a reminder or a note on the calendar
summary: Internal tasks (call the lab) or silent notes on the clinic's calendar.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Reminder
steps.details: For a silent note choose Note in the same menu.

steps.title: Title
steps.details: What needs to be done. It shows on the calendar.

steps.title: Time
steps.details: No time if you check All day.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.details: Optional: repeats every day, week or month until a date or a number of times.
